name: orbs
svg_template:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${glow-color}" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${glow-color}" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="200" height="200" fill="${color-bg}"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="90" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <g transform="rotate(${rotate-ring} 100 100)">
    <circle cx="100" cy="40" r="${size-orb}" fill="${color-a}" opacity="${opacity-a}">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="${opacity-a};1;${opacity-a}" dur="${pulse-a}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="152" cy="130" r="${size-orb}" fill="${color-b}">
      <animate attributeName="fill" values="${color-b};${glow-color};${color-b}" dur="${pulse-b}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="48" cy="130" r="${size-orb}" fill="${color-a}"/>
  </g>
  <text x="100" y="190" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="9" fill="${color-a}">${mode-mark}</text>
</svg>
